category: 扩展测试 / 论文摘要
text: Bentonite-supported calcium sulfate composites were prepared to investigate heterogeneous nucleation during gypsum crystallization. The modified surface increased the density of high-affinity sites and improved adsorption capacity without reducing the specific surface area.

category: 扩展测试 / 吸附除臭
text: The porous deodorization material removed NH3 through physical adsorption, acid-base interaction, and chemisorption, while its capacity remained above 28.4 mg/g after three regeneration cycles.

category: 扩展测试 / 石膏与膨润土
text: The cation exchange capacity of bentonite affected solute transport, whereas CaSO4·2H2O precipitation was controlled by heterogeneous nucleation on the clay surface.

category: 扩展测试 / 杀菌与微生物
text: H2O2 treatment enhanced bacterial inactivation, but excessive oxidation damaged surface functional groups that were important for clay-mediated microbial remediation.
